description:
Get historical air quality data for a site or location, with health context.

Returns a 'narrative' with plain-English interpretation, WHO 24-hour
guideline exceedance days, and guideline comparisons. Present the
narrative to users first. Also returns 'data' and a per-site 'summary'
(statistics are per monitor, never pooled across monitors).

Annual guidelines are compared only for windows of a year or more
with at least 75% data capture. Daily and monthly rows carry
'n_hours' and 'partial'; partial days (under 18 hours) are excluded
from exceedance counts. Times and days are UTC.

Args:
    start_date: Start date (ISO format, e.g. "2025-01-01").
    end_date: End date (ISO format). A date includes that whole day,
        so a window ending today includes this morning's readings.
    location: Postcode, place name, or "lat,lon". Provide this or site_code.
    site_code: Direct site code. Provide this or location.
    pollutants: Optional filter, e.g. ["NO2", "PM2.5"].
    frequency: "hourly", "daily", or "monthly" (default "daily").
name: get_historical_aq
